$comment: Web UI's slots, and where a Studio contribution to each goes in the new app (docs/business-apps/studio-migration.md, section 3). `how` is automatic (the converter does it and the harness checks it), agent-proposes (an agent suggests the target and a person accepts it) or reported (it does not migrate, and the report says why). An automatic or proposed entry names one target: an app slot from `appSlots`, or a Layer 0 key.

source.how: Every <nuxeo-slot> the installed Web UI declares in its bundles, and every slot Web UI's own <nuxeo-slot-content> elements contribute to. COLLECTION_ACTIONS is only contributed to.

reportedBecause: The app has no slot for it yet. A runtime slot comes first, decided slot by slot by demand (Studio parity plan, 10.2).

RESULTS_SELECTION_ACTIONS.what: Actions over the documents selected in a list

DOCUMENT_VIEWS_ITEMS.what: A tab's entry on a document's page

DOCUMENT_VIEWS_PAGES.what: A tab's content on a document's page

DRAWER_ITEMS.what: An entry in the left menu

DRAWER_PAGES.what: What an entry of the left menu opens

PAGES.note: A page is a custom element, so what it shows needs mapping before it can become a route.

THEMES.note: Its properties go through the token map (theme-tokens.json).

RESULTS_ACTIONS.what: Actions in the toolbar of a list of results
RESULTS_ACTIONS.note: Not per row, so not rowActions; contextMenu is the nearest, decided per package.

CREATE_POPUP_ITEMS.what: An entry in the create dialog

CREATE_POPUP_PAGES.what: A page of the create dialog

DOCUMENT_INFO_BAR.what: The bar above a document's page

FILE_UPLOAD_ACTIONS.what: Actions on a file being uploaded

TRASH_RESULTS_SELECTION_ACTIONS.what: Actions over the documents selected in the trash

PUBLISH_ITEMS.what: An entry of the publishing dialog

PUBLISH_PAGES.what: A page of the publishing dialog

USER_MENU.what: An entry in the user menu

ADMINISTRATION_MENU.what: An entry in the administration menu

ANALYTICS_ITEMS.what: An entry in the analytics menu
